expected_value_creation: Make reviewer disagreement, dissent, override, and adjudication reproducible without treating agreement, majority, or seniority as truth.
beneficiary: QIF evaluators, independent reviewers, affected stakeholders, and governance owners
supporting_evidence: QIF v0.6.36 already preserves route and resolution evidence.
Recent research reports lower human-AI agreement on subjective dimensions and proposes claim-level disagreement as a human-in-the-loop review signal.
success_criteria: Every disagreement preserves at least two independent source judgments with verdict, rationale, evidence, and confidence.
Adjudication records authority, independence, selected or new disposition, preserved originals, and rationale.
Low independence, unresolved conflict, unsupported override, conflict of interest, insufficient data, or unverified evidence trigger governance.
